# Synthetic Manifest Characterization Corpus

`corpus-manifest.json` is generated only by
`backend/scripts/generate_manifest_synthetic_corpus.py`. All 60 internal
resources are project-original, deterministic, non-personal, non-device,
non-evidentiary canonical JSON. Do not manually edit the generated manifest.
Regenerate it through the versioned generator and create a new corpus/fixture
version for an approved behavioral change.

The manifest and fixture SHA-256 values protect test assets only. They are not
evidence hashes. This corpus is not Apple-produced validation, compatibility
validation, support validation, production data, or Supported capability.

Do not add real, sanitized, redacted, pseudonymized, public, customer, device,
backup, vendor, challenge, licensed, or uncertain-provenance data here.
